_source: Vectors extracted verbatim from TransFrameTests/LLMResponseTruncationTests.swift (macOS): LLM translation batching splits + completion-state response parsing. The compatible-instance HTTP fixture (testCompatibleBatchRequestsKeepOriginalSegments) is a URLSession mock, not a pure vector — it is intentionally NOT portable here.
_fullFieldContract: batchingCases carry exact expected batch lists (order + contents) or, for the emoji-splitting vector, the exact macOS property assertions (minBatches + flat-join equality). parserCases compare ok/errorCategory and the full extracted text — never a substring.
_macOSWiringNote: macOS reads this via a future TransFrameTests loader (resolve relative to #filePath like the visual-line-grouping.json note); until then the embedded vectors in LLMResponseTruncationTests.swift are the macOS-side source of truth and this file must be updated in lock-step.
